baseline_models.focus_anchor: The comparison at word 5, the two father references at words 7 and 12, the group claim at word 10, and the verdict at words 14-15.
baseline_models.mechanism: The speakers measure paternal affection against collective solidarity and presumed usefulness. Because the larger mutually supporting group receives less love than the favored pair, they treat the allocation itself as a visible departure from the proper course.

activation_trace.role: Heart-abiding preference supplies the literal affection being treated as a scarce family resource.
Fatherhood and nurture identify the office whose differential care the speakers judge.
An encircling, mutually supporting group supplies the brothers' counterweight to the favored pair.
Departure from right direction supplies their judgment that the father's preference violates the proper course.
Manifest appearance makes the judgment sound self-evident rather than merely resentful.

changed_reading.before: The brothers complain that their father loves Yusuf and his brother more.
changed_reading.after: The complaint is a distributive accusation: collective strength is made the expected measure of paternal love, so preference for the pair is declared visibly misaligned.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The singular brother relation at word 4, heart-centered love at word 5, the bound group at word 10, and separation at word 15.
baseline_models.mechanism: The ayah sets two forms of attachment against one another: a close sibling dyad held at the heart and a larger band held by mutual binding. The band's utterance draws a boundary inside the family, so its complaint about unequal attachment simultaneously performs a new separation.

activation_trace.role: Literal kinship supplies the favored dyad within the wider sibling set.
The heart's inner core spatializes the pair as occupying the center of paternal regard.
Tight binding and winding give the larger group a materially compact form.
Separation after connection supplies the boundary that the comparison creates within the household.

changed_reading.before: Two brothers are preferred over the rest.
changed_reading.after: The ayah maps a conflict between a heart-centered dyad and a tightly bound coalition; the coalition's protest itself widens the family separation it names.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The plural saying at word 2 and the combined error-and-clarity predicate at words 14-15.
baseline_models.mechanism: Plural speech converts private hurt into a shared position. Once the group has said it together, the final claim of manifestness lets consensus function as evidence, closing inquiry by presenting a contested judgment as already visible.

activation_trace.role: Saying as a held position turns the utterance into the coalition's common doctrine.
Deviation supplies the substantive charge around which the speakers align.
Disclosure and visibility convert the aligned charge into an asserted fact.

changed_reading.before: The brothers report an obvious error.
changed_reading.after: Their plural speech manufactures a shared certainty: agreement within the band is made to stand in for proof that the father is wrong.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The favored heart-position at word 5 and the loss/hiddenness inventory activated by the accusation at word 14.
baseline_models.mechanism: Although the grammar locates error in the father, the loss and hiddenness branches allow the grievance to carry the speakers' own felt condition. The favored pair occupy the center of regard, while the coalition experiences itself as missing from view and projects that displacement onto the father's judgment.

activation_trace.role: The inner heart supplies the center from which the speakers feel displaced.
Hiddenness gives the accusation a secondary image of being absent from paternal sight.
Loss supplies the speakers' felt displacement while they grammatically assign defect to the father.
Separation makes their felt exclusion legible as a relational rather than merely cognitive wound.

changed_reading.before: The father has plainly lost the right path in his preference.
changed_reading.after: The charge may also project the brothers' own felt loss: they experience themselves as absent from the center of paternal regard and rename that displacement as the father's defect.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated markers of visibility place the brothers' emphatic verdict inside a field of competing disclosures. The book is manifest, the warned-of enemy is manifest, Joseph and his brothers are signs, and then the father's error is called manifest; the last claim can therefore disclose the speakers even while asserting something about the father.

activation_trace.role: Manifestness supplies the focus claim's force and the feature whose authority becomes contested.
Deviation remains the charge that the speakers insist has become visible.
Prior manifest disclosure supplies a higher-order use of the same visibility language.
The manifest adversary supplies a second competing object of obviousness before the brothers' verdict.
A visible sign reframes the brothers' conduct and speech as evidence to be read.

structural_cues: The same closing adjective marks the book in 12:1, the adversary in 12:5, and the brothers' allegation in 12:8.
Immediately before the focus, 12:7 frames Joseph and his brothers as signs for questioners.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated visibility language and a sign-reading frame; I infer that 12:8 can reveal the assertors as well as describe the father. A live alternative is that the repetition only intensifies three unrelated predicates.

changed_reading.before: The final adjective simply confirms that the father's error is obvious.
changed_reading.after: The phrase remains the brothers' verdict, but it also becomes a visible sign of their own posture: certainty is dramatized, not automatically ratified.

context_deltas.mechanism: A private dream report is followed by a warning that disclosure to the brothers could provoke contrivance. The plural saying in the focus, later followed by one speaker revising the group's proposal, can then be heard as an internal caucus in which shared grievance is converted into negotiable action.

activation_trace.role: Mutual discussion supplies a deliberative function for the brothers' plural speech.
The mutually supporting band supplies the social body within which deliberation can become coordinated.
The dream supplies the guarded disclosure that precedes and motivates the warning about sibling response.
Contrivance and stratagem supply the anticipated direction in which sibling resentment may move.
One speaker's intervention displays actual negotiation inside the speaking group.

structural_cues: The sequence moves from father-son disclosure in 12:4, to a ban on retelling in 12:5, to plural speech in 12:8, to one member amending the plan in 12:10.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a guarded dream, an explicit warning of a plot, and a later intra-group amendment; I infer that the focus speech is a caucus opening rather than a neutral report. It could instead be a narrator's summary of complaints voiced at different times.

changed_reading.before: The brothers voice a spontaneous shared complaint.
changed_reading.after: Their complaint is the opening motion of a deliberative process: guarded knowledge activates a coalition that turns comparison into a plot.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding promise of selection, teaching, and completed favor supplies a vocational trajectory that the brothers do not name. Their affective metric may register a real differentiation while misclassifying its cause as arbitrary paternal error.

activation_trace.role: Preference is the brothers' explicit explanation for the perceived asymmetry.
Paternal nurture supplies the human relation through which the differentiation is perceived.
Selection and drawing near supply a non-affective reason for Yusuf's distinct position.
Knowledge becoming disclosed to a knower supplies the teaching trajectory attached to that selection.
Completion supplies the long arc of favor that exceeds a momentary emotional preference.

structural_cues: The promise of selection, instruction, and completed favor in 12:6 lies between the dream warning and the brothers' comparison.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a declared trajectory of election and formation; I infer that paternal closeness may partly track discernment of that trajectory. The live alternative is ordinary unequal affection with no such causal link.

changed_reading.before: The father irrationally prefers two sons.
changed_reading.after: The brothers may correctly perceive differentiation but wrongly reduce a trajectory of selection and formation to favoritism, making their diagnosis narrower than the asymmetry they observe.

context_deltas.mechanism: The band's self-description becomes operational capacity. Alternatives of killing and casting away are negotiated, a concealing hollow is selected, and dispersed opinions become settled resolve; collective strength therefore enables the removal that the grievance demands.

activation_trace.role: Mutual surrounding and support supply the collective body that can coordinate coercive action.
Tight binding gives the coalition a material image of many agents acting as one.
Taking life supplies the most extreme proposed use of the coalition's capacity.
Casting something until it lies discarded supplies the moderated but still coercive alternative.
A depression in which something disappears supplies the selected mechanism of removal.
The unlined cut well supplies the concrete receptacle for the group's decision.
Firm resolve gathered after divided opinion converts coalition into an executable decision.

structural_cues: The branchless casting command at 12:9 word 4 stands beside killing as an initial option.
One speaker modifies the plan in 12:10, and 12:15 records the group moving with settled resolve into the chosen act.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies group binding, proposed actions, amendment, concealment, and settled resolve; I supply the causal arrow that coalition strength makes coordinated removal feasible. A live alternative is that the strength claim is only a comparison of sons, not a mobilizing boast.

changed_reading.before: Being a strong band is evidence that the father should prefer them.
changed_reading.after: Being a strong band is also the means by which preference can be forcibly rearranged; the self-description mobilizes the capacity that carries complaint into action.

context_deltas.mechanism: The brothers answer the father's alleged deviation by planning a literal displacement: remove the favored son, make paternal attention empty for themselves, place Yusuf far after or behind, and hide him in a cut hollow. The semantic field of loss is transferred from accusation to engineered condition.

activation_trace.role: Hiddenness supplies a latent dimension of the defect the brothers assign to the father.
Loss supplies the condition that the brothers subsequently impose on Yusuf.
Emptied space supplies the desired clearing of paternal attention after Yusuf's removal.
The face and what lies ahead materialize the paternal attention the group wants exclusively turned toward itself.
Causing distance supplies the temporal and relational world the brothers imagine after Yusuf.
Concealment from sight turns the focus root's latent hiddenness into a planned physical state.
A hollow that receives something supplies the spatial instrument for making Yusuf absent.

structural_cues: The proposed sequence in 12:9 is removal, exclusive paternal attention, and a new condition after Yusuf.
The concealment proposed in 12:10 is enacted with the same location in 12:15.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an accusation with loss branches and a plan of distance, emptying, concealment, and enclosure; I infer an externalization in which perceived relational disorder is solved by manufacturing actual absence. The sequence can also be read as ordinary motive and means without deliberate root-image reversal.

changed_reading.before: The father is lost because he directs love wrongly.
changed_reading.after: The accusation anticipates a reversal: the brothers try to cure the father's supposed loss of direction by making the beloved son literally lost, hidden, and distant.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exact group identity returns inside a conditional about failing to protect Yusuf. What first supported a claim to greater love becomes a standard that would make the speakers deficient if harm occurred; solidarity is now a binding liability as well as a boast.

activation_trace.role: The supporting coalition initially supplies the brothers' claimed qualification for preference.
The repeated coalition image becomes the premise that should make loss under their watch impossible.
General deficiency names what their own strength standard would expose if their protection failed.

structural_cues: The same first-person group formula appears in 12:8 and 12:14, first beside a claim to preference and then inside a conditional of failed custody.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact repetition and the consequence of deficiency; I infer that the second use tests and binds the first use as a competency claim. It may alternatively function only as reassurance to the father.

changed_reading.before: Our solidarity proves that we deserve more affection.
changed_reading.after: Our solidarity also binds us to protect: the boast creates the very standard under which our coming story of failure should condemn us.

context_deltas.mechanism: The private comparative position becomes the premise for a public campaign of reassurance. The same group asks for trust, claims purity from deceit, promises guarding, and later insists on verbal truth; the focus speech thus begins a sequence in which language is used to obtain custody and manage belief.

activation_trace.role: Deliberative speech supplies the internal formation of the position later presented to the father.
A new plural address turns internal deliberation into outward persuasion.
Settled trust names the psychological state their persuasion seeks from the father.
Purity from fraud supplies the self-characterization intended to remove suspicion.
Guarding supplies the concrete assurance by which the group seeks custody.
Truth of speech supplies the final verbal credential invoked when their account is difficult to believe.

structural_cues: Private plural speech in 12:8 is followed by plural address to the father in 12:11, a protection promise in 12:12, and an explicit truth claim in 12:17.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a speech sequence aimed at securing trust and custody; I infer that the focus grievance is rhetorically productive, not merely expressive. The later deception does not require the initial perception of unequal love to have been insincere.

changed_reading.before: The focus records what the brothers resent.
changed_reading.after: The focus also generates a persuasive program: shared resentment is organized into claims of trustworthiness, purity, guardianship, and truth that obtain control of Yusuf.

context_deltas.mechanism: The speakers who call error manifest later construct an evidentiary scene under conditions of low visibility: night arrival, performed tears, false material, inward beautification of the plan, and a narrated description. Their confidence in what is clear is thereby mirrored by an attempt to make a false account look clear.

activation_trace.role: False or attributed saying remains only a latent risk in the focus but becomes activated by the later fabricated account.
Revealing meaning by speech or sign supplies the evidentiary function the brothers later imitate.
Night darkness and reduced visibility supply the setting for a manufactured appearance.
Affected weeping supplies performed emotion as support for the account.
Contradiction of truth identifies the material token as false evidence.
The self's beautification of an act supplies the inward construction behind the outward display.
Presenting a thing through its attributed features supplies the narrative layer of the staged proof.

structural_cues: The brothers arrive at night in 12:16 and combine emotion, an object, and verbal description across 12:16-18.
The father distinguishes the displayed account from the inward process that made the act attractive.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies low visibility, affected crying, false evidence, self-beautification, and description; I infer an epistemic reversal in which those asserting obviousness later manufacture obviousness. These details could instead be only the mechanics of the later lie, without reflecting back on the focus adjective.

changed_reading.before: The brothers confidently identify a fact that is clear to them.
changed_reading.after: Their claim of clarity anticipates their own evidentiary practice: they will stage signs so that a desired description appears manifest even when it is false.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This uses the packet's non-dominant mapped target for the focus saying and is not a lexical translation of the verb. It remains worth carrying because its smallness image is visibly activated by the ayah's favored pair versus encircling plurality; downstream prose should mark it as split-root wordplay or formal resonance only.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The opening saying at word 2 is packet-mapped to a smallness branch, while words 5 and 10 explicitly oppose greater love to a coalition.

activation_trace.role: Smallness and fewness give the opening speech a form-distant image of the favored minority.
Preference supplies the unequal value assigned to that minority.
The surrounding coalition supplies the many against whom the favored few are counted.

changed_reading.before: The brothers say that two sons are loved more than they are.
changed_reading.after: As a contained formal activation, the utterance voices the scandal of fewness outranking mass: the favored minority outweighs the organized many.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The grain image belongs to a branch of the love root rather than the adjectival sense in context, so this is not an etymological gloss of the focus word. It remains anchored because the beloved is subsequently placed in a receiving hollow and the pickup verb carries a grain-gleaning branch; downstream prose should render it only as a material metaphor activated across scenes.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The love word at 12:8 word 5 carries a seed/grain branch that later meets the hollow and pickup at 12:10.

activation_trace.role: A grain that germinates supplies a latent material image for the beloved son.
A hollow receiving an object supplies the seed-like placement produced by the brothers.
Gleaning grain after harvest supplies the surprising recovery image attached to Yusuf's pickup.

changed_reading.before: Yusuf is the more-loved child whom the brothers want removed.
changed_reading.after: In a contained material reading, the beloved becomes seed-like: put into a hollow by the coalition yet positioned to be gleaned rather than erased.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is an anticipatory cross-domain activation, not a claim that 12:8 directly mentions the later garment. It remains unusually well anchored because the focus inventories include object-signification for saying and disclosure by signs, while the later falsehood inventory specifically includes a garment that lies by its condition; downstream prose should qualify it as a material echo of the brothers' speech.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The saying at word 2 and manifestness at word 15 are reactivated when a later garment is made to signify a false account.

activation_trace.role: A thing's saying through indication extends the focus speech into the later use of material testimony.
Disclosure by word or sign supplies the standard of apparent clarity that the object is made to imitate.
The garment supplies the physical sign recruited to tell the brothers' account.
A garment that lies by its condition supplies the exact counterfeit-material mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The brothers verbally pronounce the father's error manifest.
changed_reading.after: Their speech anticipates counterfeit material speech: a garment will be made to 'say' a false story through its condition, imitating the clarity they claim in the focus.

strongest_changes: The coalition claim shifts from evidence of deserving love to the operational capacity for coordinated removal.
The accusation of paternal loss reverses into a plan that makes Yusuf physically lost, hidden, and distant.
Manifestness shifts from an apparently ratified verdict to a contested sign and then to a staged evidentiary practice.
The grievance becomes both a response to guarded selection and the premise of a campaign for trust and custody.
summary.what_was_special: The most productive latent activations were the non-dominant fewness target against the many, the love-root's grain image meeting later gleaning, and object-signification meeting the branch of a garment that lies by its condition.
remaining_uncertainties: The focus plural speech may be an internal caucus, but the packet does not explicitly locate its audience.
Paternal love may track discerned selection and formation, or the preceding promise may only reframe an otherwise ordinary preference.
The split-root, seed, and speaking-garment readings are branch-backed resonances rather than lexical senses of the focus forms.
Repeated manifestness may deliberately turn judgment onto the speakers, or it may be emphatic recurrence without that reflective function.
